optimizer.objective: Maximize allocation-weighted 10-year net CAGR forecast subject to the active drawdown cap.

fundModels.forecastUse: No target fund: use the own-fund 4.00% gross scenario and deduct the complete 0.53% A PHP fee stack.
fundModels.feeBasis: A PHP KIID: 0.50% trust + 0.00% custody + 0.02% accounting + 0.01% audit + 0.00% other fees.

fundModels.forecastUse: Use the 10.61% Fidelity target-level forecast after its official 1.89% OCF, then deduct the complete 1.25% ATRAM A PHP wrapper/operating fee stack.
fundModels.feeBasis: ATRAM A PHP KIID wrapper: 1.23% trust + 0.01% accounting + 0.00% audit + 0.01% benchmark + 0.00% other = 1.25%. Fidelity's direct factsheet for A-ACC-USD, ISIN LU1046421795, reports a 1.89% OCF; this direct target-manager figure supersedes the conflicting 1.19% target TER printed in the ATRAM KIID.

fundModels.forecastUse: Use the 9.89% actual-target forecast after the non-embedded 0.245% target-fee adjustment, then deduct the complete 1.65% ATRAM A PHP wrapper/operating fee stack.
fundModels.feeBasis: Target-based 10-year model: 30% × official UCITS target annualized total return 18.15% + 70% × JPM 2026 long-term U.S. large-cap return 6.70% = 10.135%; subtract 70% × 0.35% target TER because the official historical return already includes ongoing charges, then subtract the complete 1.65% ATRAM A PHP fee stack.
fundModels.returnBasis: Actual target JPM Nasdaq Equity Premium Income Active UCITS ETF USD (dist), IE000U9J8HX9. JEPQ is excluded from CAGR and used only for DD.

macroModel.rateFormula: Weighted sum of each 3/6/12-month driver composite. Scores are model signals, not observed facts or market predictions.
macroModel.selectionRule: Twelve is the maximum distinct coverage set: every driver has an authoritative source, a unique portfolio channel, and a non-zero sensitivity to at least one required fund. Additional candidates are rejected when they duplicate an included rate, inflation, growth, liquidity, earnings, valuation, volatility or currency channel.

drawdownModel.formula: Portfolio DD is the simple sum of each allocation weight multiplied by the verified historical maximum drawdown of its documented fund, target fund, or strategy proxy. No forward-looking DD, historical/forward blend, diversification credit, or correlation adjustment is used.

funds.historicalBasis: Official ATRAM Peso Money Market Fund A PHP daily NAV maximum drawdown from 3,076 records, 16 Dec 2013 to 11 Aug 2026; used directly because the fund has no target vehicle.
funds.historicalMetric: Own-fund historical daily NAV maximum drawdown

funds.historicalBasis: Official Fidelity Global Technology Fund A-ACC-USD (ISIN LU1046421795) daily NAV maximum drawdown from 3,203 manager-chart observations, 9 Apr 2014 to 12 Aug 2026; NAV peak 28.71 on 19 Feb 2020 and trough 19.62 on 18 Mar 2020.
funds.historicalMetric: Target-fund historical daily NAV maximum drawdown

funds.historicalBasis: Official U.S.-listed JPMorgan Nasdaq Equity Premium Income ETF (JEPQ, CUSIP 46654Q203) daily NAV maximum drawdown from 1,072 manager-published observations, 4 May 2022 to 12 Aug 2026; peak 19 Feb 2025 and trough 8 Apr 2025. This raw-NAV measure is not distribution-adjusted. JEPQ is the disclosed historical DD proxy; actual UCITS target IE000U9J8HX9 remains the CAGR basis.
funds.historicalMetric: JEPQ historical daily raw-NAV maximum drawdown proxy
